title: A Hate Letter
author: soulnscript
body: As I am writing this, I have finally accepted my fate as it is and also the fact that I have no role in it. I believe we are God, we are angel and we are human and whatever we do is is written by us and we are watching things as we do them but at the same time we are unable to change anything because we are also just the audience. But after all this, I am still certain that if there were any love in my heart for you it was not written before, it was not predicted, it was not predestined or predetermined, I love you because..... I dont have any reason. I just do but l am pretty much aware that if I do, it is not written by God but I chose to Love you, despite all the things that force me not to love you and I still do; But finally, I have also come to the conclusion, the things we do without the will of God are not destined to be accomplished, Love is a sort of rebellion that is why its destiny is never fulfilled to reach the point where it should because God does not let it happen as He does not command it.

But as I rebelled in your love, it did not push me away from God but it brought me closer to him. I understood that those who rebel in love cannot be wrong, they can never be wrong no matter how much worse they go in their rebellion, because their hearts are pure and full of love, their thoughts are mystic. So I am going on a way, a path that will take me to God and I am aware that on this path, I will come across you for how can we reach God if we dismiss His creatures. I also now understand that any act of Love that I had showed towards you or i am showing is my will but the ones that were not filled with love, when I pushed you away, when pretended to be pragmatic and avoided extra imaginary instances, that was not me. That was just a foolish sinner not knowing what he was doing, covered with the cloak of satan, impure, unloved and unlovable, empty of the ability to love, and I consider that I must have sinned alot or did something unimaginable that God sent satan to make me do things with my own hands for which I now suffer on my own and if I seek vengeance I will also end up punishing myself even more. It is a state of such punishment where I am the sinner, I am the judge, the prosecutor and I am the executioner.
With a heart full of regrets at your feet,
